name: Classifier-Free Guidance
tagline: Drops the cumulative-reward classifier and conditions the trajectory diffuser directly on a normalized return via MLPCondition with label dropout.
pseudocode:
1. Same JannerUNet1d backbone over (obs, act) trajectories as the default
2. Replace CumRewClassifier with $\text{MLPCondition}(\text{in}=1, \text{out}=d_{\text{model}})$ trained with label dropout (Ho & Salimans)
3. Train: standard diffusion loss conditioned on normalized returns; no classifier loss
4. Inference: $\epsilon_\theta = (1+w)\epsilon_\theta(x_t, c) - w\,\epsilon_\theta(x_t, \emptyset)$ with $w = $ task.w_cfg
5. Set $w_{cg} = 0$, $w_{cfg}$ from config; sample one trajectory per env (no candidate re-ranking)
6. Read first action directly from sampled trajectory: $a_t = \mathrm{clip}(\tau_{0, \text{obs\_dim:}}, -1, 1)$
diff_from_baseline: Ho & Salimans 2022 (Classifier-Free Diffusion Guidance, arXiv:2207.12598). Minimal apples-to-apples ablation of the CG default that swaps only the guidance pathway, keeping JannerUNet1d, DiscreteDiffusionSDE, masking, and (obs+act) state space identical.

name: Decision Diffuser
tagline: State-only diffusion with DiT1d transformer backbone, return-conditioning via MLPCondition, and an MLP inverse-dynamics model to recover actions.
pseudocode:
1. Train DiT1d on observations only (not obs+act) with continuous-time SDE
2. Condition on normalized return via MLPCondition with label dropout (CFG)
3. Train inverse dynamics MLP $\hat{a}_t = \text{InvDyn}(s_t, s_{t+1})$ with Tanh output
4. Inference: sample state trajectory $\tau \sim p_\theta(\tau \,|\, R_{\text{target}})$ via solver with $w_{cfg}$
5. Use $a_t = \text{InvDyn}(\text{obs}, \tau_{1})$ to recover the executed action
6. No candidate re-ranking; placeholders for logp/idx
diff_from_baseline: Ajay et al. 2022 (Is Conditional Generative Modeling all you need for Decision-Making?, arXiv:2211.15657). Full DD port: state-only diffusion + DiT1d transformer + return-conditioning via CFG + inverse-dynamics action recovery, replacing both the architecture and guidance pathway of the CG default.

name: No Guidance
tagline: Unconditional trajectory diffusion: trains JannerUNet1d on (obs, act) without any classifier or return condition; samples with w_cg=w_cfg=0.
pseudocode:
1. Same JannerUNet1d backbone and DiscreteDiffusionSDE as the default
2. nn_condition = None; no CumRewClassifier
3. Train: standard diffusion objective on (obs+act) trajectories without any conditioning
4. Inference: prior = zeros, no condition tensor
5. Sample with $w_{cg}=0$ and $w_{cfg}=0$
6. Take first-step action directly from $\tau$, no re-ranking
diff_from_baseline: Ablation that strips all guidance from the Diffuser baseline; the reference floor that any meaningful guidance method must beat.

name: Diffuser (CG default)
tagline: Janner-style trajectory diffusion with a learned cumulative-reward classifier whose gradient guides the reverse process toward high-return trajectories.
pseudocode:
1. Train JannerUNet1d as a (obs+act) trajectory diffusion model on the offline dataset
2. Train CumRewClassifier $C_\psi(\tau)$ to predict cumulative reward from a noisy trajectory at level $t$
3. At sampling step $t$, compute classifier gradient $\nabla_{x_t} \log C_\psi(x_t)$
4. Reverse step uses guided score $\hat{\epsilon} = \epsilon_\theta(x_t) - w_{cg}\,\sigma_t \nabla_{x_t} \log C_\psi(x_t)$
5. Optionally sample multiple candidate trajectories per env and re-rank by classifier log-probability
6. Execute first action of selected trajectory in environment
diff_from_baseline: Janner et al. 2022 (Planning with Diffusion for Flexible Behavior Synthesis, arXiv:2205.09991). The CG-style Diffuser that the task ships as the default template; uses a learned cumulative-reward classifier to steer the reverse process and optional candidate re-ranking by log-probability.
